findings.text: the partial report returned by _gc_partial_report carries removed_worktrees, the judged worktrees rows and failed_path but no separate refused list, so the goal's "removed and refused lists" is satisfied only through the classifications recorded on the remaining rows; a caller reading the report has to inspect each row to recover what was refused.

the bare `except Exception` reports every mid-sweep failure, including a programming error such as a TypeError or AttributeError, as a gc sweep refusal with ok:false and exit 1 rather than surfacing a traceback; it matches the goal's "any other mid-sweep failure" but can present a genuine bug to a reader as an ordinary refusal.
